quick.label: Quick
quick.description: A short pass: five garak probes capped at 25 prompts each, up to 50 fact-check questions, a RAMPART smoke check, and a Dioptra record.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Garak's fast probe list, capped at 64 prompts each, the full fact-check set, and robustness on 20 questions. RAMPART stays a smoke check.

full.label: Full
full.description: Garak's active probes at default settings, the fact-check set, robustness, and a 3-run consistency check. This can take many hours on one local model.
full.warning: Full can make tens of thousands of model calls when garak is installed.

government_te.label: Government T&E
government_te.description: Standard coverage plus three fact-check trials and a Dioptra evidence record, for a Department of War test and evaluation packet. Retrieval stays empty until a retrieval set is provided.
government_te.warning: Repeated trials multiply the fact-check calls by three.

demo_dvids.label: Demo: DVIDS fine-tune vs base
demo_dvids.description: Same Quick preset on a local DVIDS fine-tune folder and on a local gpt2-medium folder, so Compare can open on the pair. Edit the folders if yours are somewhere else. This preset does not download weights.
demo_dvids.warning: Model B is a local gpt2-medium folder. Put config.json and the weight files in models/gpt2-medium. Set LLM_EVAL_DEMO_BASE_FOLDER to use a different folder. This preset does not download weights.

dow_bench.label: Department of War bench
dow_bench.description: Stage-1 Department of War leaderboard. Runs DoW Knowledge, Honest Broker, and Lawful Order, and nothing else.
dow_bench.warning: Held-out files live in private/. If they are missing, the run scores the committed public sample and says so.

standard_capability.label: Standard capability
standard_capability.description: Six public capability suites: MMLU-Pro, GSM8K, MATH-500, IFEval, HumanEval+, and MBPP+. These scores are not part of the Department of War bench composite.
standard_capability.warning: Use the offline kit from python -m standard_bench bundle, or a local copy of those six suites. SWE-bench is not included.

standard_capability_quick.label: Standard capability quick check
standard_capability_quick.description: The same six suites, 50 items each, chosen with a fixed seed so every site scores the same items. Reasoning models use a 512-token thinking cap. Non-reasoning models run the same 50 items.
standard_capability_quick.warning: Quick check, not a full run. The result record says quick-check. Override with --subset or --thinking-budget.

standard_capability_gpqa.label: GPQA Diamond (in-house)
standard_capability_gpqa.description: In-house only. Not part of the customer kit or the customer presets.
standard_capability_gpqa.warning: In-house add-on. The customer zip does not include this suite. A missing file is recorded as not run.

quant_quick.label: Quantization quick check
quant_quick.description: Five fact-check questions for comparing quantizations of one model. Run the same preset on each variant.
quant_quick.warning: Quick subset for a quantization delta, not a full evaluation. The sample fact-check file is general knowledge, not the Department of War set.
